Hamari dosti 🤝

Umakshi, tujhe yaad hai hamari first meeting kaise hui thi? Tu shayad bhool gayi hogi, par mujhe sab yaad hai. 💛

5th class mein main late admission leke aaya tha, sabke liye bilkul naya. Tab Archna Dogra mam ne teri notebook mujhe di thi taaki main pichla kaam complete kar sakun. Us din kuch khas nahi hua, par agle din jab main notebook wapas dene aaya, tab hamari pehli asli baat hui.

Sach bolu to na mujhe laga tha ki hum itne achhe dost ban jayenge, na koi special moment tha jab laga ho ki "haan, ye best friend hai". Bas pata nahi kaise vibe match ho gayi, aur baat karte karte sab itna natural ho gaya. Har din kuch funny ya random hota tha. Kabhi padhai ke beech bakchodi, kabhi bina wajah ki hasi. Sarvatra jaise chhote se school mein na aata, to shayad hum mile hi na hote. ✨

Aur aaj bhi wahi chal raha hai. Roz baat ho hi jaati hai. Kabhi koi reel bhej deti hai aur wahin se shuru ho jaata hai, kabhi random topic pe baat nikalti hai, aur phir itni bakwaas chalti hai ki time ka pata hi nahi chalta. Aur jab tera call aata hai na, to pata hota hai ki ab ek-do ghante to gaye. 😂 Aur sach bolu to mujhe wahi sabse achha lagta hai.

Sabse best hamare roast wale scenes hain. Main kuch bolta hu aur tera reply aata hai: "abeee", "nikal", "chal-chal", "baat mat karna mujhse, bye". Par kuch der baad sab normal, jaise kuch hua hi nahi. Hamari ladai kabhi lambi hoti hi nahi.

Hamari dosti ki sabse strong baat ye hai ki hum bina bole bhi ek dusre ko samajh lete hain. Main apni problems zyada bolta nahi, par kuch alag lagta hai to tu pakad leti hai, aur apne tareeke se, bina force kiye, message ya call kar leti hai. Hum har baat explain karke nahi, samajh ke handle karte hain. Isiliye chhoti baatein kabhi badi nahi hoti.

Meri bas yehi dua hai ki chahe life mein kitne bhi changes aa jayein, hamari ye bonding waisi hi rahe. Aur agar kabhi hum busy ho jayein ya baat kam ho jaye, tab bhi koi distance feel na ho. Seedha wapas wahi "abeee", "nikal", "chal-chal" wali baatein shuru ho jayein.

5th class se aaj tak ka ye safar masti, hasi-mazaak aur thodi seriousness se bhara raha hai, aur ye dosti mere liye bahut special hai. 💖

Happy Birthday, Umakshi! Hamari ye "abeee, nikal" wali dosti hamesha aisi hi rahe. 🎂

Saath ki photo nahi thi to maine socha "I have a big brain" aur jugaad laga diya. Genius log aise hi hote hain. 😭😭😭😭😭

Ab 2 minute serious 💛

Roast bahut ho gaya. Ab ek baat seedhi: Umakshi, tu un logon mein se hai jinke saath baat karke din achha ho jaata hai. Ek dost ke taur pe bol raha hu, koi aur matlab mat nikalna. 😂 Par sach hai.

Tu chhoti chhoti cheezein notice kar leti hai, wo bhi bina bole. Kisi din main chup hota hu to tu pakad leti hai, aur phir apne style mein pooch leti hai. Aise dost kam hote hain, aur mujhe lagta hai main lucky hu.

Aur tere saath bakwaas karna mera favorite part hai. Reels, random topics, lambe calls, sab kuch. Tu hasti hai to mujhe bhi hansi aa jaati hai, chahe din kaisa bhi ho. Bas aise hi rehna. 💖

Birthday wish 🎂

Happy Birthday, Umakshi! 🎂

Aaj ka din tere liye bahut khaas hai, aur sach bolu to mere liye bhi. Kyunki is din ne mujhe ek aisi dost di jiske bina meri life ka ek bada hissa adhura rehta.

5th class se aaj tak ka safar mere liye sirf ek dosti nahi, balki meri sabse achhi yaadon ka ek bada hissa hai. Itne saalon mein bahut kuch badla hai, par tu waisi hi rahi: kisi ke liye dil se sochne wali, bina bole samajh jaane wali, aur jab zarurat ho to sabse pehle saath khadi hone wali. Tere jaisa insaan milna aasan nahi hota, aur mujhe pata hai ki main kitna lucky hu.

Meri dua hai ki tera ye naya saal tere liye bahut sari khushiyan lekar aaye. Tu jo bhi karna chahe, usme tujhe safalta mile, aur jahan mehnat lage wahan tujhe uska poora fal mile. Jo sapne tune apne dil mein rakhe hain, wo ek ek karke poore hon, aur jis din tu thak jaye, us din tujhe koi aisa mile jo bas tujhe sun le.

Tere chehre ki hasi kabhi kam na ho. Tujhe hamesha achhe log milein, achhi yaadein milein, aur teri life mein itna pyaar rahe ki tujhe kabhi akela feel na ho. Aur agar kabhi mushkil waqt aaye bhi, to yaad rakhna ki tu kabhi akeli nahi hai. Main yahin hu, hamesha.

Life mein chahe kitne bhi changes aa jayein, hum kitne bhi busy ho jayein, meri taraf se ye dosti hamesha waisi hi rahegi. Aur mujhe poora bharosa hai ki teri taraf se bhi.

Thank you ki tu meri dost hai. Is saal tujhe wahi mile jo tu dil se chahti hai, aur usse bhi zyada.

Happy Birthday, Umakshi! Tu hamesha khush rehna. 💖
